template_meta.name: InScene_Wordmark_Spec_Pill_Hero
template_meta.description: A single bright, airy lifestyle photograph doubles as both backdrop and stage: a small logo badge sits top-left, a huge bold wordmark and a row of solid-fill spec-pill badges (with one differentiated 'urgency' pill in a deeper accent) float over a soft brand-tinted gradient, while the product itself rests naturally in-scene on the same surface at the bottom — not a cutout, but physically placed in the photographed environment.

user_inputs.urgency_accent_hex: [INSERT SECONDARY/DEEPER ACCENT HEX FOR THE URGENCY PILL]
user_inputs.gradient_tint_hex: [INSERT LIGHT BRAND TINT HEX FOR THE OVERLAY GRADIENT]
user_inputs.lifestyle_scene_description: [INSERT SCENE, e.g. a woman applying cream to her cheek in front of a bright bathroom mirror]
user_inputs.surface_description: [INSERT SURFACE THE PRODUCT RESTS ON, e.g. white marble vanity countertop]

rendering.style: photorealistic, bright airy commercial lifestyle photography, soft focus on the upper scene
rendering.lighting: bright natural daylight, upbeat and energetic, not moody or dim

rendering.style: extract wordmark as-is, like a small brand sticker on the photo

sections.layout: horizontal, evenly spaced, wraps to a second row if needed

elements.note: visually distinct from the other three pills — deeper/more saturated accent to draw the eye as the urgency callout

rendering.style: photorealistic, physically resting on the same photographed surface as the background scene — not a floating cutout, real contact and perspective with the surface
rendering.lighting: matches the ambient bright daylight of the scene, slightly brighter than the background since it catches the light
rendering.shadow: soft cast shadow on the surface beneath and behind the product, direction consistent with the scene's light source

generative_image_prompt: A 1080x1350px (4:5) vertical ad built from a single continuous photorealistic lifestyle photograph. The scene: {user_inputs.lifestyle_scene_description}, continuing downward into {user_inputs.surface_description} which fills the bottom of the frame, shot in bright airy natural daylight — upbeat and energetic, not moody or dim. In the top-left corner, a small white rounded pill badge sits inset from the edge, containing the {user_inputs.brand_name} wordmark logo (from the supplied logo reference) on a white background — like a small brand sticker on the photo. Over the top roughly 66% of the canvas, a soft gradient overlay sits on top of the photo, transitioning from {user_inputs.gradient_tint_hex} at the very top to fully transparent by about 66% down, so the surface and product below read clearly in bright natural light. Starting at about 34% down the canvas, left-aligned with a small margin, a huge, extra-bold wordmark set in {user_inputs.wordmark_font} reads '{user_inputs.wordmark_text}' in {user_inputs.wordmark_color_hex}, immediately followed by a bold plus-sign glyph in flat solid {user_inputs.primary_accent_hex}. Directly below at about 48% down, a medium-weight one-line subheadline set in {user_inputs.body_font} in {user_inputs.wordmark_color_hex} reads '{user_inputs.subheadline_text}'. Below that at about 56% down, a horizontal row of four solid-fill pill-shaped badges, text set in {user_inputs.body_font} Semibold in {user_inputs.wordmark_color_hex}, centered in each: three pills — '{user_inputs.spec_pill_1_text}', '{user_inputs.spec_pill_2_text}', '{user_inputs.spec_pill_3_text}' — filled with flat solid {user_inputs.primary_accent_hex}; the fourth pill, '{user_inputs.urgency_pill_text}', is the urgency callout and stands out with a deeper, more saturated flat solid fill of {user_inputs.urgency_accent_hex}. In the bottom ~35% of the canvas, the actual product (from the supplied reference image) rests physically on the photographed surface, tilted diagonally, one single product only, lit to match the scene's bright daylight with a soft cast shadow — genuinely part of the photograph, not a pasted cutout, with correct geometry (no warping or floating). CRITICAL: reproduce any printed label text on the product EXACTLY character-for-character as it appears in the reference image — do not alter, misspell, or paraphrase any word on the packaging; proofread the rendered label before finalizing. Output: 1080x1350px, 4:5 aspect ratio, RGB, photorealistic commercial ad photography, bright and upbeat mood, brand palette on text/UI elements restricted to {user_inputs.primary_accent_hex}, {user_inputs.gradient_tint_hex}, {user_inputs.urgency_accent_hex}, and {user_inputs.wordmark_color_hex}.
